items.title: FNAF WORLD - DROWNING AND TRUE ENDING
FNAF WORLD - WHO IS OUR CHARACTER?
The show will begin momentarily.
items.content: In the Deskman ending, Baby says "The show will begin momentarily. Everyone please stay in your seats."

items.title: The Voice
items.content: Right after she says that, her eyes disappear, and the only character on screen is your character, the 8-Bit Freddy.

items.title: Mimicking
items.content: After Baby disappears, we hear a garbled voice saying something, and if you pay attention, you'll notice that the voice is actually repeating what Baby said: "The show will begin momentarily. Everyone please stay in your seats". The voice MIMICS Baby.

items.title: Game Files Proof
items.content: In the game files, that is confirmed by the fact that the audio file of Baby's line is called "show.wav", and the audio file of the garbled voice mimicking her is called "show2.wav", confirming that the garbled voice really is mimicking "The SHOW will begin momentarily. Everyone please stay in your seats". Both audios are the same size too.

items.caption: Both audios are the same size
Moment they play in the scene's code

items.title: Fredbear - Death Coin
items.content: In UCN, if you set every character to level 0/20 and Golden Freddy to level 1/20, then use 10 Faz-Coins to buy 1 Death Coin, and use the Death Coin to kill Golden Freddy, instead of killing Golden Freddy, you get a jumpscare from Fredbear. And here's the twist: Fredbear's voice is the same voice that mimics Baby in FNAF World.  Golden Freddy is the only animatronic that kills you for using a Death Coin on him.

items.title: FNAF World - 8-bit Fredbear Trophy
items.content:
In FNAF World, if you go through the 4 levels in the glitched areas, you reach Old Man Consequences. Like in the Deskman ending, your character is the 8-Bit Freddy.
If you sink in the red lake, you get the Drowning Ending. That ending gives you the 8-Bit Freddy Trophy.

items.title: UCN and the Trophy Link
items.content: In UCN, if you set all animatronics to 0/20 and Old Man Consequences to 1/20, you get access to Old Man Consequences' red lake. If you sink into the red lake, you unlock the same 8-Bit Freddy trophy that you get in FNAF World for finging Old Man Consequences and sinking into the lake there. When you unlock that trophy in UCN, that triggers the unlocking of the same trophy in FNAF World. That happens because the two games share the same system registry path for save data(MMFApplications).

items.title: The Wizard Behind the Curtain
items.content:
Old Man Consequences tells our character: "Leave the demon to his demons. Rest your own soul. There is nothing else".
That indicates that the one pulling the strings and keeping the illusion of Ultimate Custom Night is our character, the 8-Bit Freddy, and that 8-Bit Freddy is actually 8-Bit Fredbear. That idea is reinforced by the fact that 8-Bit Freddy, as seen in FNAF World, has the same voice as Fredbear/Golden Freddy in UCN.

items.title: Freddy Sinking
items.content: Another indication that 8-Bit Fredbear is Golden Freddy is that, if you unlock and watch all 14 intermission cutscenes(Bear of Vengeance and Toy Chica: The High School Years) and then beat the night with a total of 9800 points, you unlock the secret final cutscene that shows Golden Freddy twitching as he sinks into the Void.

items.title: FNAF World - True Ending: FNAF 3 and 4 Connection
items.content:
In FNAF World, if you beat Scott Cawthon, you get the True Ending, in which the Yellow Eyes from the game's intro appear again, saying: "We are still your friends. Do you still believe that? The pieces are in place for you. All you have to do is find them. Rest."
That ending unlocks the Crying Child trophy. All of this is a clear reference to the Happiest Day minigame from FNAF 3, since you need to find the clocks that reference and set up the minigames you need to beat to reach the Happiest Day ending. The clocks from FNAF World and minigames from FNAF 3 are also referenced again in FNAF 4, with elements seen on the map in the post-night minigames: Toy Chica(Chica's Party), Shadow Bonnie(RWQFSFASXC), the boy holding a balloon(BB's Air Adventure), Mangle in Elizabeth's bedroom(Mangle's Quest), Bonnie and and Fredbear on the stage(Stage01), and the final minigame being a good version of the Crying Child's party.

items.title: Foxy and Bonnie
items.content: In UCN, if Bonnie and Foxy are active and you use a Death Coin on one of them, the Death Coin will remove both from that night. That behavior doesn't happen to other animatronics.

items.title: The Party
items.content: In FNAF 4, the 2 kids that put the Crying Child in Fredbear's mouth were Michael, who was wearing a Foxy mask, and the kid who was wearing a Bonnie mask.

items.title: We're Meant to Bring Back The Dead
items.content: In FNAF World, Glitchbear tells us we were "made for one thing", that we have to "leave breadcrumbs for him, help him find his way", and every time there is a new clock to find, he says "there is a task for you to complete". These clocks are the ones that set up the Happiest Day minigame.

items.caption: "There is a task for you to complete."
"You have to leave breadcrumbs for him, to help him find his way."

items.title: We Mimic Phrases
items.content: As seen in the Deskman ending, our character mimics Baby's line: "The show will begin momentarily. Everyone please stay in your seats."

items.title: "I will put you back together".
items.content: In the intro of FNAF World, the yellow eyes in the darkness says "I will put you back together". Clearly indicating that their intention is to bring the Crying Child back. In the true ending, the same character says: "The pieces are in place for you. All you have to do is find them", a clear reference to the pieces we need to put together in FNAF 3 for the Happiest Day, the ones we set up through the clocks. That means the clocks are the objective of Yellow Eyes. Those are the breadcrumbs Glitchbear spoke of.

items.title: The Objective
items.content: All that indicates that the objective of the clocks and the Happiest Day minigame wasn't to free the Crying Child's soul, it was to "put him back together" all along, which brings us back to the objective of our character.

items.title: The Identity of the FNAF World Character
items.content:
We are something that was made for the specific mission of setting up hints and leaving breadcrumbs to help a dead kid find his way back. Our objective is to bring the same kid back.

We mimic phrases.

We are connected to the digital world.

We are the Mimic program.
